candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations (and /readyz), causing order's call to payment to fail and gateway checkout to return 502. Traces show payment 503 propagating up through order to checkout; payment logs confirm 503 responses on /v1/authorizations.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment metrics show 503 on /readyz but 0 on /v1/authorizations in the 60s window, while logs show many 503s on /v1/authorizations; exact failure mode inside payment (config, dependency, crash) is not established.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s trace to payment returning 503 on /v1/authorizations; order propagates the failure to gateway. Payment logs corroborate 503s on that route. Root failure mode within payment is not yet bounded, so confidence is moderate.
